读取当前企业和时间，搜索本人有权访问的工作空间内容。: View the current organization and time, and search workspace content you can access.
查询、创建和维护待办，选择负责人、修改状态与查看历史。修改前需确认。: Find and manage to-dos, assign owners, update statuses, and view history. Changes require confirmation.
查询和管理本人的执行计划，预览未来时间，启停计划或执行一次。修改前需确认。: Manage your schedules, preview upcoming runs, pause or enable schedules, or run them once. Changes require confirmation.
读取指定地址的文字内容，用于任务中的资料参考。: Read text from a web address as reference material for your task.
读取当前企业、本人和企业时区。: Read the current organization, user, and organization time zone.
读取当前准确时间、日期及企业时区。安排日期前先读取，不猜测今天的日期。: Read the current time, date, and organization time zone before planning dates.
在当前用户可见的工作空间中搜索，返回实际资源及页面入口。: Search the workspace content available to you and return resources with links.
查询本人或有权查看的团队待办。截止日期不代表到点提醒。: Find your to-dos or accessible team to-dos. Due dates do not create reminders.
读取一条有权查看的待办及当前修改版本，修改前先读取。: Read an accessible to-do and its current revision before editing it.
查询当前待办可以选择的真实负责人，不要猜测成员编号。: Find eligible assignees for a to-do using actual member records.
查询当前用户有权筛选或分配待办的团队。: Find teams you can use to filter or assign to-dos.
创建待办。负责人省略时归本人；截止日期只是日期，不会产生定时提醒。确认后才保存。: Create a to-do after confirmation. The assignee defaults to you. Due dates do not create reminders.
修改待办。先读取当前版本；未提交的内容保留原值，明确提交空值可清除团队和截止日期: Update a to-do after reading its current revision. Omitted fields stay unchanged; explicit empty values can clear the team and due date.
将待办标为待处理、进行中、完成或取消，确认后按当前版本修改。: After confirmation, mark a to-do as pending, in progress, completed, or cancelled using its current revision.
转交待办负责人，不转交来源对话的访问权限。: Transfer a to-do to another assignee without granting access to its source conversation.
删除指定待办，按当前版本执行。: Delete the selected to-do using its current revision.
查询本人定时任务，不能查询其他成员的私有计划。: Find your schedules. Other members' private schedules are excluded.
读取本人定时任务及当前修改版本，修改前先读取。: Read your schedule and its current revision before editing it.
查询本人定时任务的实际触发与执行记录。: View the trigger and execution history of your schedules.
查询本人已雇佣且可运行的员工，创建计划时使用返回的 hireId，不会自动雇佣员: Find AI employees already available in your workspace for scheduled tasks. This does not add new AI employees.
预览规则对应的未来五次实际执行时间，不创建计划。省略时区时使用企业时区。: Preview the next five runs without creating a schedule. Uses the organization time zone unless specified.
创建本人定时任务。先选择已雇佣员工并核对未来执行时间；enabled 明确决定是: Choose an AI employee from your workspace, review upcoming run times, and confirm whether to enable the schedule before saving.
修改本人定时任务的完整设置。先读取当前内容和修改版本，修改只影响未来执行。: Update all schedule settings after reading the current revision. Changes affect future runs only.
启用或暂停本人计划的未来触发，不停止已经开始的执行。: Enable or pause future runs of your schedule. Active runs continue.
将本人计划未来使用的员工更新为当前可用的发布版本。: Update the AI employee version used by future schedule runs to the available published version.
请求立即执行一次本人已有定时任务；结果以实际排队或阻止状态为准，不表示任务已经完: Request an immediate run of your existing schedule. The result indicates whether it was queued or blocked, not completed.
删除本人已暂停且没有活动执行的计划，不删除历史执行记录。: Delete your paused schedule when it has no active runs. Execution history is retained.
